name: Shaanxi Construction Engineering Group Corporation Limited
summary: Shaanxi Construction Engineering Group Corporation Limited, through its subsidiaries, operates as a construction engineering business in China and internationally. The company engages in the infrastructure activity of buildings, bridge buildings, hotels and commercial buildings, and cultural and sports buildings; public transportation engineering; underground space development; landscaping engineering; industrial construction; and environmental protection engineering and other fields.
